mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth is below 0.1% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.1 percentage points, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a further increase in the inflation rate signals potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 114.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 114.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signals a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
